purpose: Teach: 聖なる/僧侶/悲観/電化/断食/途方/悪徳/投影

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者が聖なる祈祷を希望される場合も医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, when patients request spiritual prayer, our medical team honors that wish.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Steady eye contact. Professional but warm — this is standard care, delivered without hesitation. Even pace, grounded in conviction.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、僧侶向けの健康相談を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes — we provide health consultations tailored for clergy members through our team.
lines.style: Nod of confirmation. Warm, matter-of-fact. The tone of someone who has thought this through. No performance, just competence offered.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者の悲観的気分を医療チームで支えます
lines.en: Ren, when patients are feeling hopeless, our medical team will support them through it.
lines.style: Slight lean forward. Gentle firmness — this is non-negotiable care. Soft attack on 'support,' no distance between her and the words. Shoulders steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療機器の電化対応を、貴院、進めてますね、先生
lines.en: The medical equipment upgrades your hospital is implementing — that's impressive work, sensei.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Genuine admiration in the voice, not flattery. Slow, observant delivery. He's noticing the practical detail others miss.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、断食的療法、つまり絶食療法の効果を医療チームで検証します
lines.en: Yes — we're also evaluating the effectiveness of fasting-based therapies as part of our protocol.
lines.style: Brief pause after 'yes.' Clinical but not cold. She's presenting a considered position. Steady breath, measured phrasing. The clarity of someone who has studied this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 途方に暮れるご家族に、貴院、寄り添われますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does reach families when they're overwhelmed — that speaks volumes, sensei.
lines.style: Soft observation, not a question. Ren noticing something true about her. Slight hesitation before speaking, like he's carefully choosing words. Genuine, understated respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、悪徳商法の被害者の心のケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we also ensure victims of fraud receive proper emotional support within our care framework.
lines.style: Quiet authority. No flinch at the difficult topic. She's stating fact — this falls under their responsibility. Steady, clear. This matters.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、レントゲンの投影像を医療チームで丁寧に読影します
lines.en: Yes — our team reads X-ray images with careful attention to detail and accuracy.
lines.style: Close, almost intimate professional tone. She's speaking about precision work she takes personally. Slight slowdown on 'careful attention.' Shoulders relaxed but focused.
